config.label: Weeek API token (Weeek: Settings → API)
config.description: Weeek API token (Weeek: Settings → API). Alternative: store it with `weeeking store-token`.

config.label: true (default) — read-only mode: write tools are hidden
config.description: true (default) — read-only mode: write tools are hidden. Set false to allow changes.

config.label: Language of user-facing texts: ru (default) or en — help, tool descriptions, prompts, errors
config.description: Language of user-facing texts: ru (default) or en — help, tool descriptions, prompts, errors.

config.label: Absolute allow list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (comma/space separated): anything not listed is forbidden; a set-but-empty value is a startup error
config.description: Absolute allow list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (comma/space separated): anything not listed is forbidden; a set-but-empty value is a startup error. Cannot be combined with WEEEK_PROFILE.

config.label: Deny list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (e
config.description: Deny list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (e.g. delete-*): denied operations are hidden and rejected on call; a set-but-empty value is a startup error.

config.label: Ready access profile: executor — reads plus task and comment creation only
config.description: Ready access profile: executor — reads plus task and comment creation only.

config.label: Custom API base URL (proxy or self-hosted gateway)
config.description: Custom API base URL (proxy or self-hosted gateway).

config.label: 1 — do not read the token from the system keychain (Credential Manager / Keychain / Secret Service)
config.description: 1 — do not read the token from the system keychain (Credential Manager / Keychain / Secret Service).

config.label: Client-side request rate limit in requests per second (token bucket, retries included)
config.description: Client-side request rate limit in requests per second (token bucket, retries included). Empty or <=0 disables it; values below 0.001 are rejected at startup.

config.label: Burst capacity in tokens (default: ceil(RPS), at least 1)
config.description: Burst capacity in tokens (default: ceil(RPS), at least 1).

config.label: debug — verbose HTTP logs to stderr (no token)
config.description: debug — verbose HTTP logs to stderr (no token).
